resources.string: This app emulates a test Credit Card (research fixture)

The app answers Select PPSE (2PAY.SYS.DDF01) and the Visa (A0000000031010), Mastercard (A0000000041010), Amex (A000000025) and Discover (A000000152) AIDs. All card numbers are EMVCo 3-D Secure test profiles for reader-compatibility lab testing only - no real cardholder data, no authorizable transactions.
